title: DC Comics Essentials Batman The Dark Knight Returns #1 2016 Frank Miller Reprint
conditionDescription: Clean, bright cover with light handling wear. See photo.
descriptionText:
DC Comics Essentials: Batman - The Dark Knight Returns #1 (May 2016), DC Comics. $1.00 special edition featuring an excerpt from The Dark Knight Returns by Frank Miller with Klaus Janson and Lynn Varley; classic lightning cover. Direct sales.

Condition: clean, bright cover with light handling wear (see photo).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
